name: Chess.com Published Data API
tagline: Public player profiles, game archives, clubs, and daily puzzles from Chess.com.
description: Chess.com's free, unauthenticated Published Data API exposes public player profiles, monthly game archives (PGN/JSON), club data, tournaments, titled players, streamers, and the daily puzzle. No API key is required; clients should send a descriptive User-Agent. Rate limits are not formally published beyond fair-use guidance.

auth.details: No API key or OAuth. Public read-only endpoints; send a descriptive User-Agent identifying your app.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public data API; no paid tier for this surface

rate_limits: not published (fair use; avoid excessive concurrent requests)
use_cases: fetch a Chess.com player's public profile and ratings
list monthly game archives for a player
download a player's games for a given month as PGN or JSON
list titled players or club members
look up live streamers currently on Chess.com
